title: POST /api/integration/clients/{id}/panel and POST /api/pairing/clients/{id}/panel (4xx/504)
description: Error body. Status by code: 404 not_found; 422 deactivated, guest, not_a_panel, remote_off, unsupported, not_connected, invalid, not_in_panel_mode, not_pro, failed; 504 timeout (no answer of the app within 5 s). The integration raises a translated HomeAssistantError with translation_key panel_<code> (never fails silently). Every command – executed or rejected – is logged with the actor (event kinds panel_command / panel_command_rejected).
